tools.name: codebook_status
tools.description: Discover this exact workspace/instance, prerequisites, supported demo profile, limits and existing run resources.

tools.name: codebook_start
tools.description: Prepare the declared demo asynchronously. Same key/arguments returns its original run. Poll nextActions before clicking; one active run maximum.

tools.name: codebook_action
tools.description: Accept the next declared action from nextActions and immediately return its receipt. Reuse the same key with identical action on response loss, including after later actions. Wrong-order or repeated actions with new keys are rejected.

tools.name: codebook_continue
tools.description: Continue only the current inspected pause. Copy all continueArguments from the run resource. A stale/reserved/historical pause is rejected; read state before recovery.

tools.name: codebook_stop
tools.description: Release only this run’s owned browser/debug resources. Waits for cleanup and final evidence persistence. Captured resources stay readable.

tools.name: codebook_explain
tools.description: Save labeled agent interpretation for one committed snapshot. Supply its exact TypeScript hash and declared captured value paths; server renders observed facts. Never changes understanding.

tools.name: codebook_reveal
tools.description: Reveal the exact source location bound to this snapshot while its run is active. Rejects changed source or cleanup; read its immutable source resource after stop or drift.

resourceTemplates.name: run
resourceTemplates.description: Current readiness, nextActions, exact continuation arguments, deadline and historical references.

resourceTemplates.name: manifest
resourceTemplates.description: Profile, action expectations and exact source hashes frozen before any input, with a manifest hash.

resourceTemplates.name: events
resourceTemplates.description: Ordered events after a sequence, at most 50 per page; explicit nextUri and truncation.

resourceTemplates.name: snapshot
resourceTemplates.description: Immutable captured values and source binding; reading does not make it a live pause.

resourceTemplates.name: source
resourceTemplates.description: Sealed typescript/javascript/map bytes. These remain historical after local source changes.

resourceTemplates.name: image
resourceTemplates.description: Confirmed PNG for a phase returned by this profile/run. Each observation keeps its original phase; unavailable is explicit.

resourceTemplates.name: explanation
resourceTemplates.description: Persisted captured facts and separately labeled agent interpretation.

profiles.title: Paired cart demo
profiles.description: One local cart click with actual server and browser pauses.

items.title: Server cart mutation
items.overview: The server admits the selected cart request and adds the product to its cart state. The stop is immediately before that mutation. Source structure alone does not establish an observed execution.

items.title: Browser display update
items.overview: The browser awaits the selected cart response and updates the displayed count. The stop is immediately before the DOM update. Request correspondence requires a complete verified observation set.

profiles.title: Checkout demo
profiles.description: Add one local product, then create an order and observe purchase confirmation in the same application. No real payment.

items.title: Cart mutation
items.overview: The server admits the selected cart request and adds the product to its cart state. The stop is immediately before that mutation. Source structure alone does not establish an observed execution.

items.title: Cart update
items.overview: The browser awaits the selected cart response and updates the displayed count. The stop is immediately before the DOM update. Request correspondence requires a complete verified observation set.

items.title: Order creation
items.overview: The server checks the checkout request against the retained cart and derives the order total from its items. The stop is immediately before storing the order; its order count is still zero.

items.title: Purchase confirmation
items.overview: The browser has received the selected order response. The stop is immediately before displaying its confirmation. Captured order values and the later screen observation establish the result.

input.interpretation: At server.mts line 23 the selected tote-01 costs 24 and its cart has 0 items. The push has not executed yet. Continuing adds this product; the screen needs the later browser response.
The browser has received tote-01 at price 24 and cartCount 1. At client.mts line 29 the DOM count is about to change. Continuing also retains this cart result and enables Checkout.
